LanguageData.CC_R4L_Reason_NewMake: {PAWN_nameDef} has noticed that the colony could make {THING} at the {BENCH}, has everything it needs, and has never made one.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Reason_OldFriend: {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} are good friends, and haven't had a proper talk in days.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Reason_ReadToMe: {PAWN_nameDef}'s eyes are too poor for reading now. {OTHER_nameDef} is fond of {PAWN_objective} and reads well.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Reason_FrostHarvest: It is autumn and winter is coming. {PAWN_nameDef} has counted {COUNT} ripe plants still standing in the colony's fields.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Reason_SnowDay: There's deep snow on the ground, and {PAWN_nameDef} wants to go out in it.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Reason_GraveWord: {DEAD} died not long ago and lies buried here. {PAWN_nameDef} thought well of {DEAD}, and never said a word at the grave.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Reason_Visitors: Visitors from {FACTION} are on the colony's land, and {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't spoken with them yet.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Reason_ShrineHour: {PAWN_nameDef} is having a hard time, and holds to {GOD}. There is a shrine of {GOD} at home.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Promise_NewMake: A bill for {THING} is set first at the bench, for {FOR_nameDef} if {FOR_pronoun} can make it.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_SelfHelp_NewMake: Tired of waiting, {PAWN_nameDef} set a bill for {THING} at the bench. Remove it if you'd rather not.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Promise_OldFriend: {FOR_nameDef} will go over to {OTHER_nameDef} this evening, and the two will sit down together for a couple of hours.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Promise_OldFriendTogether: {FOR_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} will sit down together the next time they're both free.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Promise_ReadToMe: {OTHER_nameDef} will come and sit with {FOR_nameDef} this evening and read aloud.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Promise_ReadToMeTogether: {OTHER_nameDef} will read to {FOR_nameDef} the next time the two are together.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Promise_FrostHarvest: The council marks the {TARGET} ripe plants in the fields for harvest. The colony's people will bring them in.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_SelfHelp_FrostHarvest: Tired of waiting, {PAWN_nameDef} marked the ripe plants in the fields for harvest. Cancel the marks if you'd rather leave them.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Promise_SnowDay: A snow day is called: whoever is free goes out in the snow with {FOR_nameDef} in the daytime, and {FOR_nameDef} builds a snowman.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Promise_SnowDayAlone: {FOR_nameDef} runs out into the snow to build a snowman.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Promise_GraveWord: {FOR_nameDef} will go to {SUBJECT}'s grave in the daytime and stand there a while.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Promise_Visitors: {FOR_nameDef} will go over to {OTHER_nameDef} of {SUBJECT} and spend an hour with {OTHER_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Promise_VisitorsWalk: {FOR_nameDef} goes over to where {OTHER_nameDef} of {SUBJECT} is.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Promise_ShrineHour: {FOR_nameDef} will go to the shrine of {SUBJECT} in the daytime and stay a while.
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Play_OldFriend: an evening with an old friend
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Play_Visitors: an hour with the visitors from {FACTION}
LanguageData.CC_R4L_Goal_EldersRooms: Each elder in a bedroom of their own, impressiveness {0} or more ({1} / {2})
